verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Obsidian logo until the wordmark can't be read, while the headline is blown up so far that it nearly touches the Shop button. The button is also jammed against the right edge with almost no margin, which leaves the layout cramped and lopsided. B keeps the logo legible and gives the headline sensible weight, with even gutters and a properly inset CTA; its only weaknesses are that it is close to a straight proportional shrink and the headline is a little small at this size.
